channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Why has Sarwar called on Starmer to resign?
item.description: Our Scotland correspondent Kathryn Samson was at Anas Sarwar's Glasgow press conference where he urged Sir Keir Starmer to resign.

item.title: Labour MPs debate what Starmer should do next
item.description: We’re joined by two Labour MPs. Justin Madders was a government minister until he lost his job in the reshuffle last September. Samantha Niblett is the MP for South Derbyshire, elected in 2024.

item.title: Starmer will be gone after May elections, says Diane Abbott
item.description: Left-wing MP Diane Abbott was first elected as a Labour MP in 1987 but was suspended by the party last summer.

item.title: We didn’t know ‘depth of relationship’ between Mandelson and Epstein – Environment Secretary
item.description: Sir Keir Starmer is fighting for his political life tonight after Scotland's Labour leader called for him to step down. Cabinet ministers joined forces to back the Prime Minister in response. We spoke to one of them, the Environment Secretary Emma Reynolds.

item.title: Police assessing new Andrew allegations from Epstein files
item.description: The King has made clear his “profound concern” at allegations over Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor’s conduct and Buckingham Palace said he will “stand ready to support” the police if approached over the claims.

item.title: Epstein Files: Giuffre a 21st Century ‘game changer’ says Royal historian
item.description: We spoke to Royal historian Tessa Dunlop.

item.title: Ghislaine Maxwell refuses to answer questions in Congress
item.description: As the consequences of Jeffrey Epstein's abuse reverberate around Westminster and Buckingham Palace, in the US there was silence today from one of his key co-conspirators.

item.title: Ghislaine Maxwell deposition ‘laughable’ says Epstein survivor
item.description: We spoke to Jena Lisa Jones, who was just 14 years old when Jeffrey Epstein assaulted her during a massage at his house in Palm Beach. She campaigned for the release of the Epstein files.

item.title: Hong Kong pro-democracy campaigner Jimmy Lai given 20-year prison sentence
item.description: Former Hong Kong media chief and critic of China, Jimmy Lai, has been sentenced to 20 years in prison.

item.title: Starmer ‘will walk away feeling safer’ after PLP speech to save job
item.description: The Prime Minister has been meeting Labour MPs this evening to try to persuade them to keep him in office.
